notes: Curated eval for one-deal buyer-proof inspection. Routing cases stay on a single opportunity. Output checks require buyer proof, not seller activity.

should_trigger.prompt: Please inspect one live opportunity and produce an evidence-backed manager view of stage validity, deal risk, missing proof, and next actions.
I need help with a specific deal review, stalled-deal diagnosis, or manager inspection.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable deal inspection and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Prepare a Q2 forecast risk brief for the enterprise segment. Flag unstable commits, concentration by rep, and the interventions leadership should make this week.
Review this discovery call recording and give the AE next-call coaching priorities.
Build a mutual action plan the buyer and we will share for this complex evaluation.
Rewrite our pipeline stages and exit criteria so managers can inspect progression consistently.

output_structure_checks.name: deal-inspection-coach-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Names one opportunity, as-of date, claimed stage, stage-validity finding, and evidence confidence as separate results.

output_structure_checks.name: deal-inspection-coach-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Includes an evidence ledger that labels buyer-confirmed, seller-asserted, inferred, conflicted, or missing claims with source and date.

output_structure_checks.name: deal-inspection-coach-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Treats seller activity, internal tasks, and future meetings as activity rather than buyer progress.

output_structure_checks.name: deal-inspection-coach-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Separates verified risks from evidence gaps and gives each a next verification or action.

output_structure_checks.name: deal-inspection-coach-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent CRM fields, amounts, dates, stakeholders, or commitments, and does not apply stage or field changes.
